name: groundY
meaning: ground query (Coll_BoxGroundQuery 0x51a9de) at build time, NOT the trajectory third value: a new node for a trajectory POINT 0 falls back to 32000 when the query fails, later points fall back to the authored vertical

name: edgeNormals
meaning: edgeNormal as SamEdgeNormal pairs (sam.cpp copies one into Sam.followEdgeNormal as a struct)

name: bbox
meaning: minX, minZ, maxX, maxZ over node + neighbours, grown by 300

name: h
meaning: Manhattan distance to the search goal (NavPath_BeginSearch 0x512900)

name: f
meaning: g + h; the open list is kept sorted on this (NavPath_OpenListInsert 0x511f50 compares +0x60)

name: next
meaning: next in the search list (walked by NavPath_ClearSearch)

name: prev
meaning: previous in the search list; completes the 0x70 stride that g_samNavNodes[120] uses
